generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.title: Beta Jump To Block Behavior
generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.description: Allows an entity to jump to another random block.

fields.title: Cooldown Range
fields.description: Minimum and maximum cooldown time-range (positive, in seconds) between each attempted jump.
fields.technicalDescription: Check that the limits imposed on the range (minimum, maximum and maximum distance between values) are respected

fields.title: Forbidden Blocks
fields.description: Blocks that the mob can't jump to.

fields.title: Max Velocity
fields.description: The maximum velocity with which the mob can jump.

fields.title: Minimum Distance
fields.description: The minimum distance (in blocks) from the mob to a block, in order to consider jumping to it.

fields.title: Minimum Path Length
fields.description: The minimum length (in blocks) of the mobs path to a block, in order to consider jumping to it.

fields.title: Preferred Blocks
fields.description: Blocks that the mob prefers jumping to.

fields.title: Preferred Blocks Chance
fields.description: Chance (between 0.0 and 1.0) that the mob will jump to a preferred block, if in range. Only matters if preferred blocks are defined.

fields.title: Scale Factor
fields.description: The scalefactor of the bounding box of the mob while it is jumping.

fields.title: Search Height
fields.description: The height (in blocks, in range [1, 15]) of the search box, centered around the mob.

fields.title: Search Width
fields.description: The width (in blocks, in range [1, 15]) of the search box, centered around the mob.
